mapper.select: SELECT c.contract_id AS contractId, c.contract_date AS contractDate, c.monthly_equivalent_first_premium AS monthlyEquivalentFirstPremium, c.payment_term_months AS paymentTermMonths, c.standard_surrender_deduction_amount AS standardSurrenderDeductionAmount, c.insurer_id AS insurerId, po.product_offering_id AS productOfferingId, po.channel_code AS channelCode, po.standard_deduction_80_yn AS standardDeduction80Yn, p.product_id AS productId, p.product_group_code AS productGroupCode FROM fgc.insurance_contract c JOIN fgc.product_offering po ON po.product_offering_id = c.product_offering_id JOIN fgc.product p ON p.product_id = po.product_id WHERE c.contract_id = #{contractId}
